races.name: Get 100/1 On England At BetVictor EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Aperoll
runners_data.comment: 80,000gns half-sister to a US turf winner out of a well-connected maiden; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: 80,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Ghaiyyath half-sister to US 5.5f/1m turf winner Alexis Zorba; dam unplaced 5f-7f 2yo (RPR 38), sister to 6f Group 2 winner Royal Intervention; powerful stable; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Attack Attack
runners_data.comment: Dam a 7f Group 3 winner as a 2yo; yard going well, including with juveniles; good claims
runners_data.spotlight: By Palace Pier; first foal of a 7f 2yo winner (including Group 3; RPR 104), herself out of a Listed-winning sprinter; stable going great guns, including with 2yos, and she's a strong contender on paper.

runners_data.name: Avalon Queen
runners_data.comment: 50,000gns yearling; dam a Group 2 winner over middle distances; longer-term prospect
runners_data.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; by Masar; fourth foal of a French 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Group 2; RPR 111), herself a half-sister to 1m4f Listed winner Emotion, out of French 2m4f Group 1 winner Molly Malone; should have a future but more of a long-term prospect than some.

runners_data.name: Desert Sands
runners_data.comment: £40,000 breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to a 6f-1m winner out of useful 7f winner; check market
runners_data.spotlight: £40,000 breeze-up 2yo; third foal; half-sister to 6f 2yo/1m winner Callisto Dream (RPR 83); dam a 7f/7.5f winner (98); yard has had a winning 2yo newcomer this year; worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Eabha
runners_data.comment: Dam from a strong staying family; others may have her measure today
runners_data.spotlight: By Space Blues; first foal of an unraced half-sister to winning hurdler Ebasari out of a useful mare from the family of Gold Cup winners Estimate and Enzeli; others may have her measure today.

runners_data.name: Enhancing
runners_data.comment: 70,000gns half-sister to multiple 6f winner Abbey Heights; yard's 2yos going well
runners_data.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling by Too Darn Hot; sixth foal; half-sister to multiple 6f winner Abbey Heights (RPR 92); dam a maiden half-sister to US 1m1f Grade 1 winner Singhalese; stable's 2yos going well and she's a newcomer of note.

runners_data.name: Goblet
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to a useful 6f winner out of a 1m/1m2f Listed winner; yard's 2yo record modest
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to 6f winner Dance And Romance (RPR 89); dam 1m and 1m2f (Listed) winner (106), half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Cotai Glory; winning 2yo newcomers for the stable are rare, but not unheard of.

runners_data.name: Please Don't Go
runners_data.comment: 85,000euros half-sister to 4 winners; unraced dam from good family; yard's 2yos going well
runners_data.spotlight: 85,000euros yearling by Ghayyaith; eighth foal; half-sister to four winners including Fortunino (Italian 1m3f-1m7f including Listed; RPR 105), Fresnel (1m AW; 99) and Sea Lantern (1m4f; 87); unraced dam closely related to 1m4f-1m6f Group 3 winner Profound Beauty; stable has a healthy strike-rate with 2yos this year; one to note for market confidence.

runners_data.name: Tall Trees
runners_data.spotlight: £42,000 yearling; ninth foal; by Showcasing; closely related to three winners including Sash (1m including AW/USA; RPR 99) and Onight (7f AW/UAE; 96), half-sister to two winners including White Willow (9.4f-1m4f; 89); dam 1m 2yo winner (80), out of 1m2f Group 1 winner; stable 0-6 with 2yos in 2026.

runners_data.name: Wintour
runners_data.comment: 160,000euros yearling; half-sister to two useful winners; likely type on paper
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; by Supremacy; tenth foal; sister to 7.5f winner Substance (RPR 81), half-sister to winners Ejtilaab (6f/7f including AW; 116), Eqtiraan (6f-1m1f including 2yo/Listed; 114) and Licence To Conquer (7f; 73); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Majestic Missile; lots to like on paper.

runners_data.name: Scommessa Sicura
runners_data.comment: Inexperience evident but still shaped with promise when 2nd at Yarmouth last month; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Her inexperience was evident on her Yarmouth debut (6f, good to soft), drifting to the far rail over 2f out but keeping on for second behind a cosy winner; open to improvement; one to take seriously.

runners_data.name: Bai Tong
runners_data.comment: Beaten at odds-on in both starts; can win a maiden but perhaps not this one
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten odds-on favourite in both runs this spring, showing better form when second at Ripon (6f, good) two weeks ago; likely she can be found a similar race but perhaps one with fewer notable newcomers than this one.

races.name: BetVictor Backing England To Win Handicap

runners_data.name: Electrifarhh
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 65-day break with solid form figures when fresh
runners_data.comment: Not seen much racing since winning a 2yo novice; remains capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Only seen twice since winning a 1m fillies' novice as a 2yo (Polytrack), facing a stiff task on the first occasion and then not seen to best effect over 7f nine weeks ago; not fully exposed.

runners_data.name: Classic Encounter
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist off a confidence-boosting win but facing tougher opposition here
runners_data.comment: Readily saw off 5 rivals at Redcar last week (1m, good to firm); key player under penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Took full advantage of the drop into Class 4 company when readily seeing off five rivals at Redcar last week (1m, good to firm); penalised in a deeper race but he still commands serious respect.

runners_data.name: River King
runners_data.note: Prominent type who showed improved form when gelded on recent handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark upped to 1m2f at Windsor last June; gelded prior to finishing second on his reappearance/handicap debut 11 days ago (1m2f, good to soft), pulling clear with the winner having travelled strongly; a 3lb rise won't help but he isn't fully exposed and returning to 1m shouldn't be an issue.

runners_data.name: Green Triangle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with class but struggling to find his best form this season
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice in Ireland for Joseph O'Brien; retains ability but the handicapper looks to be holding the aces at present; drops in class today but may need some more weight off his back.

runners_data.name: Knights Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose 2025 winning streak has ended, now sliding down the weights
runners_data.comment: Fine 2025 campaign saw him win five times; struggled this year but cheekpieces now tried
runners_data.spotlight: A 2025 campaign that featured five wins was always going to be a hard act to follow and he has found it tough going so far this year; has slipped back to a winning mark though and cheekpieces are now given a go.

runners_data.name: Freddie's Star
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up in trip after disappointing in shorter handicaps
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two handicaps after his maiden success; new trip needs to turn things round
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in both handicaps after winning a Chelmsford novice at odds of 1-16f; hopes rest on the step up in trip having a positive effect.

runners_data.name: Noodle Mission
runners_data.note: Prominent type better on all-weather but has exploitable turf mark
runners_data.comment: Better on AW but handicapped accordingly; needs to step up on recent reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: May have needed the run at Kempton 12 days ago but he ended up well beaten; he has a lower turf mark to exploit but is a better horse on AW; others look safer.

runners_data.name: Lunario
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won over shorter last summer but struggling to recapture form
runners_data.comment: Should be well treated but 2026 efforts leave plenty to be desired
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over shorter last summer; big prices and little to cheer this year; down in the weights but he has plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Jakarta
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 228-day absence with mixed recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winning juvenile (maiden/nursery) who was off for 324 days before showing mixed form in three starts from September last year, just failing in Newmarket handicap (1m, good) but lesser shows either side of that; she missed two runs on account of the ground (good to firm) last month; tongue-tie now added; looks on a handy mark.

runners_data.name: North View
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with course-winning form here but inconsistent this season
runners_data.comment: Course winner; on winning mark; mixed bag this year but he's capable if things fall right
runners_data.spotlight: Produced a strong finish to win a competitive 7f handicap here as a 3yo; first win since when making a successful stable debut at Chelmsford in January (7f); in and out since but he's on a winning mark and the ability is there if things pan out favourably.

runners_data.name: The Third Star
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner who should get uncontested lead from this field
runners_data.spotlight: 7f maiden win on AW last April; faced some stiff tasks afterwards and came up short; well backed on last month's seasonal/stable debut (7f, AW), staying on best (fastest final-furlong sectional) for fifth in a race not run to suit; worth another crack at 1m on that evidence; may yet do better.

runners_data.name: Herculeus
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won here but has been well beaten in three subsequent starts
runners_data.comment: C&D winner last August but three heavy defeats have followed; plenty to prove
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner last August (good ground; cheekpieces first time); three heavy defeats have followed and he comes here with plenty to prove.

races.paceDynamic: The Third Star will take them along at a sustainable pace with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure him early. Behind him, Electrifarhh, River King, Freddie's Star, Noodle Mission and Herculeus will create a wall of prominent runners, setting up potential traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up brigade of Classic Encounter, Green Triangle, Knights Gold, Jakarta, North View and Lunario will need clear runs from the back as the pace quickens. This shape strongly favours front-runners and early prominent horses who can secure clear sailing positions before the congestion develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Third Star gets an easy lead and the prominent pack gets bunched up
scenarios.body: The lone leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasing pack becomes gridlocked in mid-division. Early positioning proves decisive as those who secure the rail or outside berths early can't be caught.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners spread out nicely and avoid early interference
scenarios.body: The pace becomes honest but manageable, setting up a cavalry charge from those who travelled smoothly in the front rank. Hold-up horses get their chance but the prominent racers have first run on them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to track The Third Star
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart in the final two furlongs for those who raced keenly. The patient hold-up horses who got cover and clear runs sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If The Third Star goes too slow and gets swamped by the prominent brigade early
scenarios.body: No one wants to make the running and the race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole. This tactical mess favours horses with a high cruising speed who can quicken from anywhere.

watchPoints.text: The Third Star must be monitored for early pace - if he goes too slow he'll get swamped by the prominent brigade
Traffic developing at the two-furlong pole as five prominent runners converge on limited racing room
Classic Encounter and Green Triangle need significant pace bias to overcome their hold-up styles against this field composition
River King's recent gelding operation may have unlocked improvement that handicap mark doesn't reflect
Electrifarhh's 65-day break could be crucial - watch for sharpness in the preliminaries

races.name: Favourite Things Boosted Daily At BetVictor Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bold Shout
runners_data.comment: £52,000 half-brother to four winners; starts out at a realistic level; check the market
runners_data.spotlight: £52,000 yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Rainbow Royal (6f-1m 2yo including Italian Group 3; RPR 102), Rose Mamara (5f-7f; 83), Nibras Rainbow (7f-10.6f; 69) and Yellow Dream (French 10.4f AW); dam 6f winner (including Listed; 96); starts out at a realistic level; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Majestic Ruler
runners_data.comment: 220,000gns yearling; half-brother to a Group 3 winner; starts out at a realistic level
runners_data.spotlight: 180,000euros foal, 220,000gns yearling; third foal; half-brother to 7f/1m4f winner Caught U Looking (including 2yo Group 3; RPR 104); dam unraced half-sister to winners Mix And Mingle (7f Group 3) and Double Or Bubble (6f/7f Group 3); tongue tied for debut; looks the part on paper.

runners_data.name: Sea Cookie
runners_data.comment: Second in both 2yo runs last summer, the first over C&D; gelded/wind op since latest
runners_data.spotlight: Second over C&D on last July's debut and he filled the same spot at Wolverhampton one month later; gelded and had a wind op since last seen; should be in the thick of it.

runners_data.name: Jellystone Park
runners_data.comment: Good front-running second at Doncaster last month; now tongue tied; bold bid expected
runners_data.spotlight: Promise at Lingfield in March (6f, AW) and duly stepped forward when a front-running second of ten at Doncaster last month (6f, good; beaten a nose); now tongue tied; leading form claims.

runners_data.name: Miss Nightcap
runners_data.comment: Shaped nicely in 2nd behind a useful winner on last month's Windsor debut; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: She was an unconsidered 40-1 shot prior to her Windsor debut last month (6f, good to firm) but she ran well for second, unable to live with the winner, who has since won a handicap in good style off a BHA mark of 85, in the final furlong; can do better and shouldn't be underestimated.

runners_data.name: Velvet Goldmine
runners_data.comment: 28-1 and well beaten in a Newmarket fillies' maiden last October; bred to do better
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 when a well-beaten eighth of 11 in a Newmarket fillies' maiden (7f, good) last October; bred to do better at some point.

runners_data.name: Fozzy Osbourne
runners_data.comment: 300-1 when a never-dangerous ninth of 12 at Salisbury nine days ago (6f, good); no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: 300-1 when a never-dangerous ninth of 12 at Salisbury nine days ago (6f, good); no appeal.

races.name: Pump Technology Jonathan And Natalie Handicap

runners_data.name: Aces Wild
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent course form, beaten by Faustus twice last summer but track knowledge gives him a solid chance
runners_data.comment: Two good C&D runs last summer and he arrives on the back of a Bath win; should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Ran twice over C&D last summer and performed with great credit on both occasions, finishing second to Faustus in July and filling the same position one month later; career-best effort when winning at Bath last week (5f, firm); penalty demands more but he can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Spring Bloom
runners_data.note: Aging hold-up horse on a losing streak but Goodwood second last month shows he retains ability at this level
runners_data.comment: Capable at this level but it is over three years since his last 5f win; each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: His losing run is gathering momentum and he has not won over 5f for three years; went close at Goodwood last month (5f, good) though and he should remain a potent force at this level.

runners_data.name: Merrimack
runners_data.note: Prominent racer suits the likely tempo, 7lb claimer is a tactical bonus and recent Windsor third gives confidence
runners_data.comment: Solid third at Windsor three weeks ago; held by two of these on a C&D run last summer
runners_data.spotlight: Better strike-rate on turf than AW; solid third at Windsor three weeks ago (for Chloe Lyons) and has a chance if in the same form; finished behind a couple of today's rivals in a C&D handicap last summer.

runners_data.name: The Feminine Urge
runners_data.note: Hold-up type dropping in weight with decent Bath form, but backwards step last time raises slight concerns
runners_data.comment: Not kicked on from her promising stable debut in two runs since; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well for third on her stable debut at Bath in April (5f, good); fair effort three weeks later but she took a backwards step 20 days ago; edging down the weights but others look safer.

runners_data.name: Harry Brown
runners_data.note: Form pick after course win three weeks ago, hold-up style perfect for this race shape and 4lb rise looks manageable
runners_data.comment: Came from off the pace to win at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last time; chance up 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Took advantage of a career-low mark to land his first win on turf at Lingfield (good to firm) three weeks ago; up 4lb but he has the ability to deal with it.

runners_data.name: Faustus
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader with strong course record but inconsistent 2024 form means he's vulnerable if pace collapses
runners_data.comment: 2-3 over C&D; mixed in 2026 but if he's to revive it's likely to be under these conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Three C&D runs have yielded two wins and a fifth (in Class 3 company); has only run to form once this year, finishing third to Harry Brown at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last month; below par last time but if he is to revive it is likely to be under these conditions.

runners_data.name: Hint Of Humour
runners_data.note: Class act returning after 73-day break, multiple wins last year but hold-up style needs perfect pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Made good progress on AW since last seen on turf; needs a bit more to defy this mark
runners_data.spotlight: First past the post four times in succession in the second half of 2025 (demoted to fourth on the third occasion); she has carried on the good work this year, finishing second in three of her four starts; more required to defy this mark and she still has a bit to prove on turf.

runners_data.name: Unico
runners_data.note: First attempt at 5f on 28th career start suggests connections clutching at straws, others hold stronger claims
runners_data.comment: On a winning mark but below par on her last two runs and drops to 5f for the first time
runners_data.spotlight: Back to a winning mark and last month's return to action saw her caught out wide at Kempton; drops to 5f for the first time on her 28th start; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: Faustus will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front runners to challenge him early. The sustainable tempo will allow prominent racers like Merrimack to track comfortably while the large hold-up contingent (Aces Wild, Spring Bloom, The Feminine Urge, Harry Brown, Hint Of Humour, Unico) settles at the back. This tactical setup creates a moderately-run race over 5f where the field will be bunched turning for home, setting up a sprint finish. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and patient hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as they won't be compromised by early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Faustus leads uncontested and the field remains bunched into the straight
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows closers to wind up effectively while Faustus may tire late. Harry Brown and Aces Wild can unleash their finishing speed from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Faustus kicks clear early and maintains his advantage to the line
scenarios.body: His proven course form and tactical advantage prove decisive as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late. Merrimack stays on best of the rest from his tracking position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Merrimack positions perfectly behind Faustus and times his challenge to perfection
scenarios.body: The 5lb claimer Chloe Lyons produces a tactical masterclass as Merrimack's recent Windsor form translates perfectly. The leaders and hold-up horses cancel each other out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Charge Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The sprint becomes a lottery as Hint Of Humour's class and The Feminine Urge's weight advantage prove crucial. The early leaders compound completely.

watchPoints.text: Faustus breaking slowly would create pace chaos as no other natural leaders exist in this field
Watch for Merrimack positioning early as Chloe Lyons' 7lb claim becomes crucial if she secures the perfect tracking spot
Harry Brown's jumping from the gates after his Lingfield success will determine if he can get the ideal hold-up position
Monitor the pace after two furlongs - if Faustus goes too fast early the hold-up brigade will swamp him late
Spring Bloom needs checking for market confidence given his recent poor run and 30-day absence

races.name: South Downs Water Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Naval Tribute
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose visor addition has sparked two good turf performances, though 24 days off and trip extension poses questions
runners_data.comment: Has done well since switched to Flat turf for his last two starts; high on the list
runners_data.spotlight: Has done well since switched to Flat turf for his last two starts with the visor added, winning at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) in April before second of 12 in an apprentice handicap at Ascot (2m, good) last month (winner followed up at Chester on Saturday); up just another 1lb and high on the list.

runners_data.name: Baileys Khelstar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long absence but easier grade than recent Hamilton effort suggests competitive chance
runners_data.comment: 1lb higher than for his last win, which came over this trip; this is easier than last time
runners_data.spotlight: Missed the whole of 2025; needs to put a lesser effort in a 0-95 contest at Hamilton (1m5f, good) last month behind him, but this is easier and he is just 1lb higher than for his last win, which came over this trip.

runners_data.name: Now The Eagle
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with proven stamina but all recent form on all-weather, making surface switch the key concern
runners_data.comment: Form of last three starts at Kempton reads 122; something to prove under these conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French; no questioning his stamina with the form of his last three starts at Kempton (2m, AW) reading 122; has something to prove under these conditions, though.

runners_data.name: Vaguely Royal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse winless on Flat since 2023 despite recent placed efforts, needs more than consistency suggests
runners_data.spotlight: Third in his last three starts, but may not have achieved that much and remains without a win on the Flat since the end of 2023; others more compelling.

runners_data.name: Personal Best
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who may have needed recent Salisbury return after long break, better handicapped than recent efforts suggest
runners_data.comment: May have needed last month's Salisbury return but good to firm ground would be a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent since handicapping including a win at Ffos Las (1m6f, soft) just under a year ago; may have needed last month's Salisbury return (1m6f, good), but good to firm ground would be a concern.

runners_data.name: John Galt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fine attitude who just broke maiden at Leicester, rapid turnaround from breakthrough win
runners_data.comment: 3lb higher than when narrowly off the mark last time; shortlisted if staying longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Showed a fine attitude when just getting the better of a subsequent winner to make it seventh-time lucky on turf debut at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) last month; 3lb higher, but remains unexposed and is shortlisted if seeing out the longer trip (stays 1m6f).

runners_data.name: Calvert
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner whose consistency gives him tactical control, though yet to win in 20 career starts
runners_data.comment: Only just behind Naval Tribute when third at Ascot last month; should go well again
runners_data.spotlight: 1-20, but no doubting his consistency and was only just behind Naval Tribute when third of 12 in an apprentice handicap at Ascot (2m, good) last month; has had more chances than his old rival, but should again go well from the same mark.

runners_data.name: Barenboim
runners_data.note: Prominent early but woeful 0-18 turf record including hurdles makes him hard to fancy despite right weight
runners_data.comment: 6-31 on the AW and 0-18 on turf, including six starts over hurdles; others more solid
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1lb above his last winning mark, but is 6-31 on the AW and 0-18 on turf, including six starts over hurdles; others more solid.

races.paceDynamic: Calvert will take the field along at a sustainable gallop with only Baileys Khelstar and Barenboim showing any inclination to race prominently early. The single confirmed front-runner should dictate terms without pressure, allowing him to control fractions over this stamina test. With six of eight runners confirmed hold-up horses, the pace will be honest but not taxing, creating a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw speed. This race shape heavily favours the pace-setters and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the back half of this small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Calvert Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Calvert gets an easy lead and maintains his rhythm without serious early pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: The front-runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the straight, while late closers get caught in traffic behind the wall of hold-up horses. His consistency and tactical advantage from the front make him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Baileys Khelstar or Barenboim press Calvert early and force stronger fractions through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for the army of hold-up horses, particularly those with proven stamina like Naval Tribute and Personal Best. Calvert's effort could flatten out in the final furlong under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the bunch of hold-up horses get bottled up behind the leaders turning for home with limited room to manoeuvre.
scenarios.body: The horses who can find clear running earliest will have a crucial advantage, likely favouring those with the sharpest tactical speed. Jamie Spencer's experience on Vaguely Royal could prove decisive in finding gaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If honest fractions throughout expose any horses lacking the staying power for this trip on good to firm ground.
scenarios.body: The proven two-mile performers will come to the fore late, with Now The Eagle's recent Kempton form over this distance looking particularly relevant. The surface change from all-weather to turf adds an extra question mark.

watchPoints.text: Calvert getting a soft lead early - if Baileys Khelstar and Barenboim fail to apply any pressure, he could prove unstoppable
Traffic developing turning for home with six hold-up horses bunched together behind a slow pace
Now The Eagle's adaptation from all-weather to turf given his recent Kempton dominance was on a completely different surface
Naval Tribute's visor having the same positive effect it showed in his last two improved performances
Personal Best showing signs of returning to form after what looked like a needed run at Salisbury last time

runners_data.name: Princess Rascal

runners_data.comment: Low-key return to action last month but progressive in 2025 and she should be sharper now

runners_data.name: Twisting Physics
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner with Jamie Spencer's tactical skills, headgear applied suggests connections expect improved effort
runners_data.comment: Two creditable runs this year; tongue-tie added today; could still have more to offer
runners_data.spotlight: Won two of his first four starts, including at this track on his handicap debut last June (7f, good); both runs this season have been respectable and he could take a step forward with a tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: Aphrodite Spirit
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 266 days off track is a major fitness concern despite showing improvement as a three-year-old
runners_data.comment: Unexposed but she is conceding race fitness to her rivals; this may not be her day
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of her three runs as a 3yo, getting off the mark when upped to 1m2f at Lingfield (AW) last September; unexposed but she is conceding race fitness to her rivals and this may not be her day.

runners_data.name: Morcar
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner with Pat Dobbs able to find gaps, returning from wind surgery with mixed recent form
runners_data.comment: On a fair mark and conditions will suit but not shone yet this year; takes on improvers
runners_data.spotlight: 1lb lower than for his last win; two runs back from wind surgery haven't been his best and he is taking on some potential improvers today.

runners_data.name: Victors Spirit
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but switching from hurdles to flat handicaps, Jack Callan's 3lb claim useful for this grade
runners_data.comment: On the up since switched to handicaps but this might prove too competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Fell in both hurdle starts, after which he was rerouted to the Flat; made a successful handicap debut at Southwell (1m3f, hooded first time) in April and two runs since have both been respectable; more needed to come out on top in this field.

runners_data.name: Ted Le Saux
runners_data.note: Front runner likely to be involved in early pace battle, Andrew Balding stable but doesn't appear ahead of his mark
runners_data.comment: Down the field on his handicap debut in April; mark looks high enough
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field on his handicap debut at Haydock in April (extended 1m2f, good to firm); in good hands but doesn't appeal as being ahead of his mark.

runners_data.name: Bintabuha
runners_data.note: Prominent runner changing stables from William Knight to Harry Charlton, 51 days since last run questions fitness
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 1m2f handicap at Wetherby last April but found life tougher afterwards (highly tried); left William Knight prior to her Yarmouth reappearance, a race where she shaped as though the run would bring her on; better expected this time.

runners_data.name: Nanino Niyati
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who showed good form on stable debut at Ascot, Callum Rodriguez retains the ride from that effort
runners_data.comment: Solid 4th on seasonal/stable debut at Ascot last month; others perhaps better treated
runners_data.spotlight: 1m2f winner for the Kublers last season; not beaten far into fourth in an Ascot handicap (1m2f, good to firm) on her stable debut last month; after just six runs she may do better but such progress is essential.

races.paceDynamic: Twisting Physics, Nanino Niyati and Ted Le Saux will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with Princess Rascal, Morcar, Victors Spirit and Bintabuha all wanting prominent positions creating congestion and traffic problems. The strong early pace will stretch the field and test stamina over this demanding 1m2f trip on good to firm ground. Hold-up horses like Wanderlust and any runner able to secure clear water will benefit from the expected collapse of over-racing prominent runners. This race shape strongly favours patient tactics and horses with proven stamina reserves who can finish through tired horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed leaders go too fast early and the prominent brigade gets into a speed duel
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will set up a perfect scenario for late closers with stamina, as the pace-setters and prominent runners tie up in the final two furlongs. Wanderlust's hold-up style and French stamina breeding becomes a major asset when others stop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders drops out early leaving a more measured pace through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with less early pace, suiting horses that can travel strongly and have a good turn of foot rather than pure stamina. Princess Rascal and Morcar's prominent styles work better in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Twisting Physics or Nanino Niyati can control the fractions and avoid getting into a speed battle
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and holds on as the prominent horses struggle to close the gap having been caught wide or in traffic. Jamie Spencer's tactical nous on Twisting Physics could prove decisive if he can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Muddle Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too slow early creating a bunched field and sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leads to a cavalry charge with traffic problems throughout the field, favoring horses with the best recent form and race fitness. Morcar's experience and Pat Dobbs' ability to find gaps becomes crucial in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Twisting Physics and Nanino Niyati could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in an early speed duel
Princess Rascal, Morcar, Victors Spirit and Bintabuha all want prominent positions creating potential traffic problems turning for home
Aphrodite Spirit's 266-day absence makes her fitness highly questionable despite her previous improvement pattern
Wanderlust's hold-up style could prove decisive if the expected strong pace materializes as anticipated
Watch for Jamie Spencer dropping Twisting Physics out if the early pace becomes too fierce
